contexts.text: In these (colours) the red represented the goods of love; and the white, its truths.
The first came forth red () = the good of life.

That red = the good of life, is derived from the fact that all good is of love, and love itself is celestial and spiritual fire... It is also compared to blood... and as both of these are red, good... is signified by red. Illustrated.
His eyes shall be red with wine () = (the Divine good).
Wherefore art Thou red as to Thy garment () = the good of truth.
More ruddy than ruby gems () = the good (in the Divine Human).

As red signified good, especially the good of the Natural, ... it was commanded that the covering of the Tent should be of the skins of red rams; and also that the water of expiation should be made of the ashes of a red cow burned... As the colour red signified this, the coverings of the Tent were interwoven... with threads of scarlet, crimson, and hyacinthine.
In the opposite sense, red = the evil of the love of self. Illustrated.
Though they be red like crimson ().
The shield of the mighty is made red ().
Behold a great red dragon ().
There came forth another horse, red ().
Let me sup of the red, this red () = a longing for doctrinals... apparently good... For Esau had from this the name Edom, which, in the Original, is red.
Red () = the good of the Natural.
These interior things as to good are signified by the blood and its redness.
Redness, is predicated of good.
These things are signified in special by red, and by white; but by red, the good of love, and by white, the truth of faith.
By a red cow is signified unclean truth of the Natural.
His eyes red with wine = that His Intellectual is nothing but good; for red = the good of love, and this from fire, and from blood, which are red. AE 433:4. AE 556:21.
The red horse = reasonings from the cupidities of evil. ( = the understanding of the Word destroyed as to good. DSS 12:2. AR 305. AE 364.)
Good, as to colour, is presented as blue, yellow, and red.
Redness () is predicated of the good of love which is in the truths.
This is signified by crimson, because by the colour red is signified the good of celestial love.

There are two fundamental colours, red and white... The reason the colour red = the good which is of love, is that it descends from fire... Hence all other colours, in proportion as they derive from red = the good which is from love... AC 9833:end, AC 9865:2.
Skins of red rams = external truths which are from good.
The reason (the ruby, topaz, and carbuncle = the celestial love of good) is their red and flaming colour; and red = love... here, celestial love, because they are in the first row.
The ruby... is derived in the Original from a word which means redness.
The stones in the second row derive from a blue which is from red. Explained.
By the garment which was red () is meant (the Divine good of) the Word, on which violence had been inflicted. AE 922:5.
The dragon is called red from love merely natural.

The blood is red from the correspondence of the heart and the blood with love and its affections. For, in the Spiritual World, red and white are the fundamentals of all colours... The red colour there corresponds to love... for the reason that it derives its origin from the fire of the Sun... Hence the blood cannot but be red, and indicate its origin.
Red, in the Word, is predicated of goods, because it derives its origin from the fire of the sun.

There are two fundamental colours (there)... The red derives its origin from the fire of the Sun. Thus... the celestial Angels, being in the good of love, are in that flaming light, and therefore are clothed in red. Hence, also, these two colours are in the precious stones there...

By red () is signified good destroyed... because by red is meant the infernal red which is from infernal fire, which is the love of evil. Red, which is the infernal red, is shocking and abominable, because there is nothing living in it, but all is dead.
That red is said of the love of both good and evil. Illustrated.
Like things are predicated of the colours which derive from red; as scarlet and crimson.
The reason the dragon is called red, is that red = the falsity from the evils of concupiscences, which is infernal falsity.
(An army upon red and black horses, seen.) AR 839:3, Explained. TCR 113.

There are, in general, two colours which are pellucid in precious stones; red, and white. All the other colours... are composed of these through the medium of black; and by the colour red is signified the good of love... for the reason that it derives its origin from the fire of the sun; and the fire of the Sun of the Spiritual World, is, in its essence, the Lord's Divine love; thus the good of love.
Love is man's... vital heat... The redness of the blood is thence.

What makes the beauty of the face, but redness, and whiteness, and the lovely intermingling of the one with the other? Is not the redness from love... for love is red from its fire... In Heaven... I have seen the redness of whiteness in the wife, and the whiteness of redness in the husband.
White [as the animal spirit], or red [as the grosser blood].
The fire of Gehenna is redder.
a. Naked reddish horses, on which sat small naked reddish [riders]. Seen.
He obtained communication with Heaven by extending what was red...
Newton said that there are three planes of colours... red from fire...
By the red horse () is meant the quality of their understanding as to good at first.
Red = the quality of a Thing as to good.

Therefore there are two fundamental colours there... the red colour derives its origin from the flaming light, which is from Divine good... and therefore in proportion as colours derive from red, they signify good.

Moreover, the red colour = both the quality of a Thing as to good, and the quality of a Thing as to evil; for this colour... comes forth (also) from the flaminess in Hell which is from the fire there, which fire is like a charcoal fire. Hence the red in Heaven is a quite different red from the red in Hell. The red in Heaven is resplendent and living; but the red in Hell is shockingly dull and dead. Moreover, the red of Heaven vivifies; whereas the red of Hell mortifies. The reason is that the life from which is the red, is, in its origin, love...
The red of this horse, in the original Greek, is said from fire, (thus from love and pride). AE 714:10.
That red = the quality of a Thing as to good. Illustrated.
A red cow = the good of man's Natural.
As red-rubrum = the quality of a Thing as to good, the names and Things derived from the same word in the Original = the good ex quo; (as) Adam, Edom... and odam (ruby). Explained.
In the opposite, red = the quality of a Thing as to evil. Illustrated.
Red is said from love in both senses, celestial and diabolical. (In reference to the dragon, it = the love of self.)
That pure light presents variegations of colours in objects according to the reception of wisdom by the Angels, a red colour in proportion as their wisdom derives from good...
